qualifier: telomerase extension and C-strand fill-in synthesis
name: Telomere maintenance via telomerase and C-strand synthesis
rationale: All members concern telomere end maintenance (protein recruitment to telomeres, telomerase assembly and extension, packaging, recombination inhibition); the C-strand fill-in steps and telomerase extension distinguish it from confusables centred on recombination-based maintenance, capping and Cajal body trafficking.

qualifier: regulation of TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9
name: Regulation of endosomal TLR7, TLR8 and TLR9 signaling
rationale: Every member concerns signaling or regulation of the endosomal nucleic-acid-sensing TLR7/8/9 receptors (including SLC15A4-TASL-IRF5 and TLR8-BAFF), whereas the confusables centre on cytosolic sensors and type I interferon production.

name: Responses to anesthetics, ethanol and chemical stress
rationale: Most members are cellular responses to drugs, anesthetics, ethanol, ether, antibiotics, hypoxia and oxidative stress (with outlying amine metabolism and developmental apoptosis terms); the ethanol, ether and anesthetic responses distinguish it from confusables focused on mitochondrial respiration or other xenobiotics.

name: B cell receptor signaling and its regulation
rationale: All members concern BCR signaling, its second messengers, RAS/BTK activation, CD22 and inhibitory tuning, and resulting B cell proliferation; the B cell antigen receptor focus separates it from T cell receptor and G-protein confusables and from B cell development or marker modules.

qualifier: proton-coupled peptide transport and host-pathogen metal exchange
name: Proton-coupled peptide transport and host-pathogen metal exchange
rationale: Members cover proton/oligopeptide cotransport (dipeptides, oligopeptides, histidine), vacuolar transport and iron/heme exchange at the host-pathogen interface; the peptide cotransporters and pathogen-interface metal acquisition distinguish it from amino acid transporter, systemic iron homeostasis and histamine confusables.

name: Regulation of axon regeneration and collateral sprouting
rationale: All members concern stimulation or inhibition of axon growth, regeneration and sprouting (including RHOA-mediated inhibition and ceramide signaling); collateral sprouting distinguishes it from myelination, semaphorin repulsion and p75NTR death-signaling confusables.

name: Tight junction paracellular transport and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members combine tight junction adhesion and paracellular transport with magnesium transport and homeostasis, reflecting paracellular cation (magnesium) flux; the magnesium focus separates it from chloride cotransporter, aquaporin and sodium/potassium transport confusables.

qualifier: chemiosmotic ATP synthesis rather than complex assembly
name: Mitochondrial electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: All members describe electron flow through the respiratory chain and coupled ATP synthesis, whereas every confusable concerns respiratory complex assembly, membrane insertion or mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: endothelial fluid shear stress and platelet activation
name: Integrin-Rap1 signaling in shear stress and platelet activation
rationale: Members share integrin activation, Rap1 signaling and adhesion-cytoskeleton coupling, applied to endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear and to platelet activation; the shear-stress (PIEZO1) context distinguishes it from Rho/ROCK, G12/13, PECAM leukocyte adhesion and platelet GPCR confusables.

qualifier: misfolded protein quality control and atypical ubiquitin chains
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: All members concern ubiquitin chain formation (K6/K11/K27/K29, branched), proteasomal and degron-rule catabolism, ERAD and misfolded protein handling; proteasomal quality control distinguishes it from autophagy-, deubiquitinase- and proteasome-assembly-centred confusables.

name: Axon guidance by ephrin, netrin and L1-family cues
rationale: All members concern axon guidance and growth cone attraction or repulsion; ephrin, netrin/DCC, semaphorin, L1/CHL1 and DSCAM cues distinguish it from confusables centred on SLIT-ROBO commissural guidance and dendrite self-avoidance.

name: Collagen and basement membrane extracellular matrix assembly
rationale: Members cover collagen synthesis and crosslinking, laminin and basement membrane assembly, elastic fibres, hemidesmosomes and integrin-matrix interactions; matrix construction distinguishes it from confusables focused on ECM degradation, cornified envelope or myogenesis.

qualifier: germinal center with T follicular helper support
name: B cell differentiation and proliferation with T follicular help
rationale: Members concern B cell development, differentiation (B-1, germinal center) and proliferation, together with ICOS co-stimulation and Tfh differentiation that drive germinal center responses; the Tfh/ICOS help distinguishes it from CD27, memory B cell and B cell marker confusables.

core: Execution phase of regulated cell death
qualifier: apoptotic nuclear dismantling and necroptosis regulation
name: Apoptotic execution-phase nuclear dismantling and necroptosis regulation
rationale: Members concern the execution phase of apoptosis (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown) and regulation of necroptotic death; this terminal stage distinguishes it from mitochondrial, p53 and death-receptor initiation confusables.

name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates, pyruvate and carnitine
rationale: Members are solute-carrier transport of tricarboxylates, succinate, monocarboxylates, pyruvate, carnitine and the malate-aspartate shuttle, plus disorders of such carriers; carnitine, monocarboxylate and shuttle transport distinguish it from amino acid, organic cation and lactate confusables.

name: FLT3 mutant signaling, CBL regulation and inhibitor resistance
rationale: Every member concerns FLT3 receptor signaling, its CBL-mediated negative regulation or tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of FLT3 mutants, separating it from KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR confusables.

name: Replicative DNA unwinding and break-induced replication
rationale: Members share replicative DNA synthesis machinery (DNA unwinding, polymerase activation, mitotic replication, break-induced replication repair); replication-driven helicase function distinguishes it from telomere, recombination repair and replication-initiation confusables.

name: T cell immunological synapse formation and polarization
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse assembly, raft localization, T cell polarity and Vav1/RHO cytoskeletal signaling downstream of CD28; the synapse and polarity focus distinguishes it from CORO1A-DEF6, antigen presentation and chemotaxis confusables.

name: Polyamine metabolism and methionine salvage
rationale: Members cover synthesis, interconversion and oxidation of putrescine, spermidine and spermine plus the linked methylthioadenosine-methionine salvage; the salvage branch distinguishes it from confusables centred on ODC regulation, polyamine transport and hypusination.

name: Insulin receptor signaling and GLUT4-mediated glucose uptake
rationale: Members concern insulin receptor activation and attenuation, AKT2/IRS signaling, GLUT4 exocytic translocation, glycogen synthesis and glucokinase regulation in target tissues; peripheral insulin action distinguishes it from beta-cell insulin secretion and PGC-1alpha confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine receptor release, SERCA-mediated reuptake and ER calcium in striated (skeletal) muscle contraction and fiber-type switching; the skeletal context distinguishes it from cardiac conduction and contraction confusables.

name: Epidermal barrier formation via cornified envelope assembly
rationale: All members concern keratinocyte terminal development, cornified envelope assembly and skin barrier establishment, distinguishing it from keratinocyte proliferation-regulation and ichthyosis lipid-metabolism confusables.

name: Chaperone-mediated autophagy and aggrephagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members concern lysosomal clearance of proteins via chaperone-mediated autophagy, microautophagy and aggrephagy with aggresome formation and reduced protein folding/mitochondrial targeting; autophagic routes distinguish it from proteasomal quality control, ERAD and stress granule confusables.

name: Regulation of osteoblast and osteoclast differentiation
rationale: All members regulate osteoblast or osteoclast differentiation, proliferation, fusion and bone resorption, distinguishing it from mineralization, IGF response and mesenchymal stem cell confusables.

name: Methionine cycle, choline and carnitine metabolism
rationale: Members cover methionine and S-adenosylmethionine metabolism, salvage and inherited methylation-cycle defects together with choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis; these distinguish it from cobalamin, folate and other vitamin metabolism confusables.
